label: Actual recipient withholding can preserve contingent giving in every world
paraphrase: In a two-world frame with universal access, the same necessary giver gives being factively to a contingent recipient in every world. It gives the actual contingent recipient being in the actual world, and withholds being from that recipient in a world where the recipient is absent and a replacement receives being. The model assigns the giver power for the actual contingents' joint absence using the existing positive-outcome power assignment. Neither world lacks contingent concreta. This is a control on the supplied frame.
